title: Greek Theme
description: A custom items and sheilds that are greek themed.
body:
# GreekTheme

GreekTheme is a Paper plugin that adds Greek-inspired custom items using Paper item data and a matching resource pack.

## Features

- Greek-themed collectible items
- Custom shields
- Custom swords
- Bronze and Olympian armor item icons
- Included resource pack with 32x32 pixel-art textures
- In-game item command with tab completion

## Commands

Use `/greekitem list` to see all available items.

Examples:

```text
/greekitem drachma
/greekitem hoplon_shield
/greekitem bronze_xiphos
/greekitem olympian_chestplate
```

## Permissions

```text
greektheme.greekitem
```

Default: server operators only.

## Installation

1. Put `GreekTheme-1.0.0-paper.jar` in your Paper server's `plugins` folder.
2. Put `GreekTheme-Pack.zip` in your Minecraft resource packs folder, or provide it to players as a server resource pack.
3. Start or restart the server.

## Notes

This is a Paper plugin, not a Forge/NeoForge/Fabric mod. The items are custom Paper item stacks and require the resource pack for custom textures.

Armor has custom item icons. Custom worn armor models/textures can be added in a later version.
